title: Joint Benefit and Harm Probabilities under Low-Entropy Latent Confounding
banked_reason: General referee: the delivered exact joint set is an exact representation rather than an operational solution for intermediate entropy budgets; the only field lift is the still-open, underspecified rank-free BH-CERT theorem.
gap_reasons: The framing correctly leaves BH-CERT and contact inference open, but the delivered ‘exact joint set’ is an exact representation rather than an operational solution for intermediate entropy budgets.

Replace the non-effective compactness argument with the claimed finite certification procedure, first closing the balanced contact instance and then extending the construction uniformly over the three-state program. The proof must handle zero latent masses and active entropy equality without a local rank assumption.

The requested uniformly terminating exact algorithm quantifies over arbitrary real inputs without an input/oracle model, certificate language, exact-witness representation, or singular equality decision semantics.
proof_attempt_summary: The D stage established a positivity-free exact three-state representation, a sharp three-state necessity witness, a two-state no-effect face, the exact common-entropy origin threshold, strict insufficiency of its observed-MI relaxation, and conservative whole-set coverage. Math and decision reviews passed, but the field-tier general review required a rank-free terminating BH-CERT at zero weights and entropy contact. That effective-certification theorem remains open because the demanded algorithm did not specify finite inputs, certificate semantics, or exact witness representation.
tldr: Average effects conceal simultaneous benefit and harm, while existing low-entropy-confounding work studies scalar causal restrictions. The focal object is the exact joint set \(\Theta_\kappa(P)\) of benefit and harm over factual-compatible common-latent SCMs. The proved population kernel is a global exact three-state representation, an iff common-entropy threshold for universal no individual effect, a full-support law showing that the entropy-implied observed mutual-information inequality is necessary but not sufficient for origin feasibility, and, under treatment positivity, the zero-budget Fréchet segment, high-budget factual rectangle, and a star kernel at every intermediate budget. A finite-sample proposition maps an exact multinomial region into conservative whole-set coverage. Rank-free BH-CERT termination and the regular-versus-contact Hausdorff law remain explicit open questions.
gap: JiangWeiKocaoglu2023 uses mutual-information consequences of low latent entropy for scalar causal bounds; Zhang2024 gives tight binary causal partial identification conditional on a specified full marginal law \(P(U)\); and Pena2023 and GabrielSachsJensen2024 bound benefit or harm without mapping their jointly attainable entropy-indexed plane. None treats an unknown \(U\) restricted only by \(\operatorname{Ent}_Q(U)\leq\kappa\) and identifies the joint cross-world plane. The response-function and interval literatures do not certify the image at zero latent masses or active entropy equality.
fill: The project supplies the exact causal factor program and its proposed three-state reduction, derives the sharp origin threshold and global star-kernel geometry, and subjects the computational claim to a balanced-channel early-kill test. Exact whole-set coverage is retained as the supporting deterministic image of an imported multinomial coverage event.
